description.zh: 文本小工具:统计字数、提取话题标签、生成标题候选。纯本地计算,无需任何权限。
description.en: Small text utilities: count words, pull out hashtags, draft title candidates. All local, no permissions needed.

description.zh: 统计文本的字数、词数与预计口播时长(按 4.5 字/秒)。
description.en: Count characters and words in a text, and estimate read-aloud time (at 4.5 characters per second).

description.zh: 从文案中提取 #话题# 与 #hashtag 标签。
description.en: Pull #topic# and #hashtag tags out of a piece of copy.
